status: source-informed execution contract before new endpoint fits
prior_exposure: Paper, notes, earlier A10/A2 outputs and supplemental schema have been inspected; not an unseen-data preregistration.

R1.status: source-informed reconstruction; unspecified source implementation choices are declared
R1.scaling: z-score within plate/day over all nonmissing imaging wells including controls, sample SD (ddof=1)
R1.fit: OLS with intercept and target indicator, matched plates only; already centered/scaled; original values not logged again
R1.uncertainty: OLS technical-well interval only; no independent-preparation inference
R1.multiplicity: BH across eligible target p-values separately for each day and endpoint
R1.sensitivity: Repeat scaling with tdTomato omitted; preserve primary and sensitivity side by side
source_uncertainties: original scale/transformation of deposited mean area
original scaling set and joint-day handling

R2.gene_id: retain stable IDs; reject duplicate IDs; annotations and library joins explicit
R2.normalization: edgeR TMM on all nonzero genes across species-QC-retained libraries
R2.DE: limma::voom then lmFit/eBayes separately per target, with plate covariate when multiple plates
R2.comparison: target against combined reference within matching plates
R2.postfit_filter: AveExpr >1.5; units limma voom average log2 CPM
R2.multiplicity: BH per target over the full nonzero fitted gene universe, then apply AveExpr filter; source order unresolved
R2.versions: current locally installed limma 3.68.5 and edgeR 4.10.5; not a pinned recreation of source package versions
R2.source_comparison: Compare common stable IDs against S4/S5 logFC with source-selected universe explicitly reported; no independent validation
R2.outputs: Full matrices and DE tables ignored; compact QC, effects, concordance and records tracked

R3.source_table_reconstruction: S6 target activities and S7 gene projections, 20 components; retain source component identities
R3.panels: Exact figure marker panels below; not complete pathway scores
R3.cpca: Do not substitute ordinary PCA or choose alpha to match plots. Exact scPCA/source alpha unavailable; mark coordinate reproduction incomplete.
R3.ica_refit: No substitute FastICA; source JADE and source input/model settings required for exact refit
R3.top_gene_display: 200 most absolute gene_zscoreOfProj per source component, retain sign; explicitly declared ordering variant if original signed ranking differs

R4_extensions.program_summary: arithmetic mean of per-gene log2(TMM CPM +0.5) after summing CPM for duplicate symbols; all panel genes required
R4_extensions.primary_unit: target-associated within-screen descriptive contrasts; wells remain technical
R4_extensions.primary_contrast: NKX21 versus same-plate TIGIT+TDTOMATO; separate source gene and fixed-panel results
R4_extensions.growth_association: Spearman across per-target effects on common eligible targets; report association without biological p-values
R4_extensions.depth_controls: Report correlations with log mouse and human library size in both compartments and exclude depth-driven interpretation; controls receive same checks
R4_extensions.growth_conditioned: Exploratory linear residual comparison using coverage-growth effect, report both before and after; no mediation/direct effect inference
R4_extensions.leave_out: Remove NKX21 and each focal target separately from target-level association diagnostics; no independent validation claim
R4_extensions.E2: joint IFN/hypoxia/transition/AT2 panel contrasts, source ICA13/ICA5 activities; no trajectory/fate claim from bulk
R4_extensions.E3: compare source ICA17 and Wnt/AT1 panels for ELOVL1/ATP6V0E against nominated controls
R4_extensions.E4: source ICA5 and fixed panels for SLC34A2; never score the targeted Slc34a2 gene as evidence for its own state
R4_extensions.E5: receptor expression in source compartments only; exact DepMap release/denominator and normal AT1 function remain distinct eligibility gates
R4_extensions.E6: source expression/DE and editing/recipient evidence audit, not a new AREG fit or claim of EGFR dispensability
R4_extensions.E7: bulk programme response may run; heterogeneity requires eligible single-cell/spatial evidence
R4_extensions.E8: PLIN2 is a sentinel only, not a complete lung-specific lineage programme; multi-organ specificity remains untested

unresolved_gene_spelling: AT1 Spock2 must be checked against source Fig S7; if source differs, withhold this panel pending a documented amendment before scoring.

R5.action: metadata and public-asset eligibility audit first
R5.biological_n: paper reports two animals per group; bins do not increase n

output_policy: versioned run directory, refuse overwrite; retain all failures and source deviations
